name: Ogano (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ogano town emblem in red: an outlined ring enclosing a lozenge of four segments.
history: Municipal flag of Ogano, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 February 1937.

features.role: Ogano town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a lozenge of four segments
